proposition: Nafsat II names Shaykh Muḥammad al-Jazarī (d. 833/1429) as the reputation his enemies hide behind, dismissing him as learned only in Quran reading and some hadith and as having risen in Fars through native Arabic and ruler's favour.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing from exile to Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh
